sn50.99-108:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave, oghā. katame cattāro …pe… bhāvetabbāti. (vuttanayeneva vitthāretabbāni.) 6. 10. 120. uddhambhāgiyasuttaṃ pañcimāni bhikkhave, uddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
sn50.99-108:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya pañcabalāni bhāvetabbāni.
sn50.99-108:1.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhābalaṃ bhāveti, nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ. viriyabalaṃ …pe… paññābalaṃ bhāveti, nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ.
sn50.99-108:1.8: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya imāni pañca balāni bhāvetabbānīti.
